title: GetCategoryAttributes
label: LAZADA · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Use this API to get a list of attributes for a specified product category.
html:
Request Address

GET/category/attributes/get
RegionBase URL
Vietnamhttps://api.lazada.vn/rest
Singaporehttps://api.lazada.sg/rest
Philippineshttps://api.lazada.com.ph/rest
Malaysiahttps://api.lazada.com.my/rest
Thailandhttps://api.lazada.co.th/rest
Indonesiahttps://api.lazada.co.id/rest

Common Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
app_keyStringYesUnique app ID issued by LAZADA Open Platform console when you apply for an app category
timestampStringYesThe time stamp of the request e.g. 1517820392000 (which translates to 5 February 2018 08:46:32) with less than 7200s difference from UTC time
access_tokenStringNoAPI interface call credentials
sign_methodStringYesThe HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature
signStringYesPart of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click <a target='_blank' href='https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/doc?nodeId=10450&docId=108068'>here</a> for details)

Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
primary_category_idStringYesidentifiers of category code
language_codeStringNoLanguage code indicates the type of language you would like to translate. Please note not all languages are available in every region. For example, in Indonesia, only English and Indonesia are available. If you are passing a language code which does not belong to your area, null value might receive. Please do make sure your language code is correct. Supported language codes are listed as below: English:"en_US" - available in every area Singapore:"en_SG" - available in Singapore Thailand"th_TH" - available in Thailand Indonesia:"id_ID" - available in Indonesia Vietnam:"vi_VN" - available in Vietnam Philippines: "fil_PH" - available in Philippines Malaysia : "ms_MY" - available in Malaysia Default(if null is passed): "en_US"

Response Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
dataObject[]NoResponse body
  advancedObjectNoWhen the attribute is key attribute, is_key_prop = 1. When the attribute is not key attribute,  is_key_prop = 0.
  labelStringNoHuman-readable display name of the attribute
  nameStringNoName of the attribute
  is_mandatoryNumberNoWhether the attribute is mandatory
  attribute_typeStringNoAttribute type
  input_typeStringNoAttribute input type (text, date,numeric,img,rich text, singleSelect，multiSelect,enumInput,multiEnumInput) multiEnumInput/multiEnumInput supports custom value
  optionsObject[]NoList of all option nodes
    nameStringNoOption name
    en_nameStringNoOption name in English
    idNumberNooptions id
  is_sale_propNumberNoWhether the attribute is sale property
  idNumberNoattribute id
  unitObjectNo{ "precision": 1, "type": [ "inch", "cm" ], "numericMin": "1", "numericMax": "999" }
    typeString[]No[ "inch", "cm" ]
    numericMinStringNo1
    numericMaxStringNo999
    precisionNumberNo0

Error Codes

CodeDescriptionSolution
E57E057: No attribute sets linked to that category. No attributes are linked to the specified category.
E4228Query category is not activeThe category ID in the request is in Inactive state and cannot be used. Please call GetCategoryTree to query the latest category.
E4227Query category is nullThe category ID in the request does not exist in the current country, call the GetCategoryTree API to query the latest category list.
E4227Query category is nullThe category ID in the request does not exist in the current country, call the GetCategoryTree API to query the latest category list.
E4228Query category is not activeThe category ID in the request is in Inactive state and cannot be used. Please call GetCategoryTree to query the latest category.

E4227Query category is nullThe category ID in the request does not exist in the current country, call the GetCategoryTree API to query the latest category list.
